summary: Plugins extend Ansible's core and run on the control node in the ansible process, unlike modules which run on targets; they handle data transformation, output, inventory and more, and must be Python.
questions: Where do plugins run compared to modules?
Can I write an inventory plugin for my own JSON data source?

answer_card.title: Plugins overview
answer_card.answer_md: Plugins run on the **control node** inside `/usr/bin/ansible`, while modules run on targets in separate processes. Plugins transform data, log output, connect to inventory, etc. They must be **Python**; e.g. an inventory plugin can connect to any JSON-returning source.
